phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: A freeze dryer, also known as a lyophilizer, primarily used in pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries to preserve delicate products by removing moisture through sublimation.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The freeze dryer is an industry-standard piece of equipment essential for preserving heat-sensitive biological materials such as vaccines, biologics, and enzymes. It operates on a standardized process involving freezing, vacuum drying, and product removal or reconstitution stages, making it a critical component in pharmaceutical manufacturing and research facilities globally.

components.name: Manifolds (Chamber/Refrigeration)

components.name: Electrical Distribution Unit
